# lunar-swift solar astronomy subset

Upstream: https://github.com/6tail/lunar-swift

Version: 1.1.8

Pinned commit: `a7ec0e9b29f84a5d98b09b9ffd31145f17470d56`

Original `Sources/LunarSwift/ShouXingUtil.swift` SHA-256: `e442f23965259357d3b7ef16adf4e9dcd713935fd2ebeef05580c92f674bdbdf`

License: MIT; full notice is in LICENSE and the vendored Swift source header.

`Sources/LingxiCore/Vendor/ShouXingSolar.swift` contains the original NUT_B, DT_AT and XL0 numerical tables and the unmodified solar-longitude/Delta-T/qiAccurate equations. Unused lunar and ancient-calendar routines were removed. The class was renamed to an internal enum, class functions became static functions, and tables became immutable. No astronomical coefficients were generated by a model.

The application restricts chart dates to 1901–2099. Boundary instants are computed estimates using the upstream Delta-T model; precise-looking seconds are not a guarantee of astronomical accuracy. Compare recorded births close to a boundary with an authoritative ephemeris. Official cross-checks: Hong Kong Observatory Almanacs 2025 and 2026, times UTC+8.
